name: @arcgrove/polite-cli
description: Zero-dependency Node modules for CLI tools that play a rate-limited text game through its API: argv parsing with typo detection, a rolling-hour request budget, an HTTP client that never auto-retries writes, env-only token handling, JSONL records, cooldown scheduling from the action response, an expected-value option picker with safety gates, raw-total tallies, and derived-table gates (shrink guard, source stamps). PLAYBOOK.md is the step-by-step analysis guide for a new game.
author: ArcGrove
